# Component gallery

<!-- Generated by `WRITE_COMPONENT_CATALOG=1 npm test -- component-catalog` from frontend/src/kit/catalog; do not edit. -->

Catalog `veyndo:components/1`, version 1.0.0. Each component of the
[design system](design-system.md) with its document props, slots, events,
accessibility contract and examples. The examples below are rendered from
their documents by the same renderer that Studio, the storefront, app
surfaces and MCP Apps use: on the left in the light theme with English
samples, on the right in the dark theme with German samples. Studio shows
the interactive gallery under **Developer → Components**, with every
shipped language. The machine-readable catalog is
[`catalog.json`](../frontend/src/kit/catalog/catalog.json).

}

}

  padding: 2px var(--vy-space-2);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-pill);
  background: var(--vy-color-panel);
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--vy-font-weight-medium);
}
.vy-badge[data-tone="accent"] {
  background: var(--vy-color-accent-soft);
  color: var(--vy-color-accent);
}
.vy-badge[data-tone="positive"],
.vy-notice[data-tone="positive"] {

}
.vy-badge[data-tone="warning"],
.vy-notice[data-tone="warning"] {
  color: var(--vy-color-warning);
}
.vy-badge[data-tone="danger"],
.vy-notice[data-tone="danger"] {
  color: var(--vy-color-danger);
}
.vy-notice {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--vy-space-3);
  padding: var(--vy-space-3) var(--vy-space-4);

  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-md);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
}
.vy-notice[data-tone="accent"] {
  border-color: var(--vy-color-accent);
  background: var(--vy-color-accent-soft);
}
.vy-notice div {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--vy-space-1);
}
.vy-empty {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: var(--vy-space-2);
  padding: var(--vy-space-8) var(--vy-space-4);
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
  text-align: center;
}
.vy-empty h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-lg);
}
.vy-empty p {
  margin: 0;
}
.vy-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--vy-space-1);
}
.vy-field > label {
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-md);
  font-weight: var(--vy-font-weight-medium);
}
.vy-field-hint,
.vy-field-error {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-sm);
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
}
.vy-field-error {
  color: var(--vy-color-danger);
}
.vy-input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: var(--vy-space-2) var(--vy-space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-sm);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  font: inherit;
}
.vy-input.vy-input {
  border-color: var(--vy-color-border);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
}
.vy-input.vy-input[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: var(--vy-color-danger);
}
.vy-check,
.vy-switch {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vy-space-2);
}
.vy-check {
  display: flex;
  width: fit-content;
}
.vy-check input {
  width: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0;
}
.vy-switch button {
  position: relative;
  width: 40px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-pill);
  background: var(--vy-color-panel);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.vy-switch button span {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  left: 2px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-pill);
  background: var(--vy-color-muted);
  transition: transform var(--vy-motion-fast) var(--vy-motion-easing);
}
.vy-switch button[aria-checked="true"] {
  border-color: var(--vy-color-accent);
  background: var(--vy-color-accent);
}
.vy-switch button[aria-checked="true"] span {
  background: var(--vy-color-accent-text);
  transform: translateX(16px);
}
.vy-dialog-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: var(--vy-space-4);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vy-color-text) 40%, transparent);
}
.vy-dialog {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  gap: var(--vy-space-3);
  width: min(520px, 100%);
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 2 * var(--vy-space-4));
  overflow: auto;
  padding: var(--vy-space-6);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-lg);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  box-shadow: var(--vy-shadow-lg);
}
.vy-dialog h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-xl);
}
.vy-dialog > p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
}
.vy-dialog footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: var(--vy-space-2);
}
.vy-tabs [role="tablist"] {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--vy-space-1);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.vy-tabs[data-orientation="vertical"] {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: var(--vy-space-4);
}
.vy-tabs[data-orientation="vertical"] [role="tablist"] {
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 0;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
}
.vy-tabs [role="tab"] {
  padding: var(--vy-space-2) var(--vy-space-3);
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.vy-tabs [role="tab"][aria-selected="true"] {
  border-bottom-color: var(--vy-color-accent);
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  font-weight: var(--vy-font-weight-medium);
}
.vy-tabs [role="tabpanel"] {
  padding-top: var(--vy-space-4);
}
.vy-menu {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}
.vy-menu-list {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 900;
  top: calc(100% + var(--vy-space-1));
  left: 0;
  display: grid;
  min-width: 180px;
  padding: var(--vy-space-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-md);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--vy-shadow-sm);
}
.vy-menu-list [role="menuitem"] {
  padding: var(--vy-space-2) var(--vy-space-3);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-sm);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.vy-menu-list [role="menuitem"]:hover:not(:disabled),
.vy-menu-list [role="menuitem"]:focus-visible {
  background: var(--vy-color-hover);
}
.vy-menu-list [role="menuitem"][data-tone="danger"] {
  color: var(--vy-color-danger);
}
.vy-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.vy-stack[data-direction="row"] {
  flex-direction: row;
}
.vy-stack[data-wrap] {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.vy-stack[data-align="start"] {
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.vy-stack[data-align="center"] {
  align-items: center;
}
.vy-stack[data-align="end"] {
  align-items: flex-end;
}
.vy-card {
  display: block;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: var(--vy-space-5);
  border: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-lg);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--vy-shadow-sm);
}
.vy-card > header {
  margin-bottom: var(--vy-space-3);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--vy-space-3);
}
.vy-card > header :is(h2, h3, h4) {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-lg);
}
.vy-sf-card,
.vy-sf-summary,
.vy-sf-cart,
.vy-sf-account {
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  font-family: var(--vy-font-family);
}
.vy-sf-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-lg);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
}
.vy-sf-card a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.vy-sf-card-media {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  aspect-ratio: 5 / 4;
  background: var(--vy-color-panel);
}
.vy-sf-card-media img,
.vy-sf-summary-media img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.vy-sf-placeholder {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 160px;
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-sm);
}
.vy-sf-stock {
  color: var(--vy-color-positive);
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-sm);
}
.vy-sf-card-media .vy-sf-stock {
  position: absolute;
  inset: var(--vy-space-3) auto auto var(--vy-space-3);
  padding: 2px var(--vy-space-2);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-pill);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
}
.vy-sf-stock[data-empty] {
  color: var(--vy-color-danger);
}
.vy-sf-card-body {
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  gap: var(--vy-space-2);
  padding: var(--vy-space-4);
}
.vy-sf-card-body h3,
.vy-sf-card-body p {
  margin: 0;
}
.vy-sf-card-body > p:not(.vy-sf-kicker, .vy-sf-price) {
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-md);
}
.vy-sf-kicker {
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-xs);
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.vy-sf-price {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--vy-space-2);
  margin: 0;
}
.vy-sf-price strong {
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-lg);
}
.vy-sf-price s,
.vy-sf-price small {
  color: var(--vy-color-muted);
}
.vy-sf-card-link {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--vy-space-3) var(--vy-space-4);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  color: var(--vy-color-accent);
  font-weight: var(--vy-font-weight-medium);
}
.vy-sf-summary {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: var(--vy-space-8);
}
.vy-sf-summary-media {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-lg);
  background: var(--vy-color-panel);
  aspect-ratio: 5 / 4;
}
.vy-sf-summary-body {
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  gap: var(--vy-space-4);
}
.vy-sf-summary-body h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-2xl);
}
.vy-sf-summary-body > p {
  margin: 0;
}
.vy-sf-summary .vy-sf-price strong {
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-xl);
}
.vy-sf-buy {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: end;
  gap: var(--vy-space-3);
}
.vy-sf-buy label {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--vy-space-1);
  font-size: var(--vy-font-size-sm);
}
.vy-sf-buy input {
  width: 96px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: var(--vy-space-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--vy-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--vy-radius-sm);
  background: var(--vy-color-surface);
  color: var(--vy-color-text);
  font: inherit;
}
.vy-sf-summary:not(:has(> .vy-sf-summary-media)) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.vy-sf-rating {
  justify-self: start;
  padding: 0;

## Card

A titled surface that groups related content, with optional header actions.

**Kind** layout · **Source** `kit/ui#Card` · **Since** 1.0.0 · **Surfaces** studio, storefront, app, mcp-app

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | no |  |
| `level` | number \| number \| number | no | `3` |

- Slot `children`: The card body. Accepts any, at most 50.
- Slot `actions`: Header actions such as a badge or a button. Accepts `Badge`, `Button`, `LinkButton`, `Menu`, at most 3.
- Accessibility: A section with a heading at the level the document sets.

## Button

Triggers an admitted host action. Without an admitted action it renders disabled.

**Kind** atom · **Source** `kit/ui#Button` · **Since** 1.0.0 · **Surfaces** studio, storefront, app, mcp-app

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes |  |
| `tone` | "primary" \| "secondary" \| "ghost" \| "danger" | no | `"secondary"` |
| `size` | "sm" \| "md" | no | `"md"` |
| `busy` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | `false` |

- Event `press`: The button was activated by pointer, Enter or Space.
- Accessibility: role `button`; keys Enter, Space; Busy sets aria-busy, disables the button and shows a decorative spinner.

## TextInput

A labelled single-line text field. The value stays in the view until committed.

**Kind** atom · **Source** `kit/ui#TextInput` · **Since** 1.0.0 · **Surfaces** studio, storefront, app, mcp-app

## CheckoutSteps

Where the buyer is in checkout; it never implies a confirmed payment.

**Kind** pattern · **Source** `kit/storefront#checkout-steps` · **Since** 1.0.0 · **Surfaces** storefront, mcp-app

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `current` | "details" \| "review" \| "complete" | no | `"details"` |

- Accessibility: role `list`; The current step carries aria-current=step.

## AccountOverview

The account home: greeting, counts and recent orders of the signed-in customer.

**Kind** pattern · **Source** `kit/storefront#account-overview` · **Since** 1.0.0 · **Surfaces** storefront

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (host data) | string | yes |  |
| `counts` (host data) | object | yes |  |
| `orders` (host data) | object[] | yes |  |
| `recent` | number | no | `2` |

- Event `open`: The customer opened an order or account page.
- Accessibility: role `region`; Personal data; only the storefront account host admits it.

## OrderList

The signed-in customer's orders.

**Kind** pattern · **Source** `kit/storefront#order-list` · **Since** 1.0.0 · **Surfaces** storefront

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orders` (host data) | object[] | yes |  |

- Event `open`: The customer opened an order.
- Accessibility: role `list`; Personal data; only the storefront account host admits it.
